text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from about 104,325 to 91,489, but that decline alone does not tell me whether any stock is worth holding or buying.","With no trades so far, I have avoided reacting to monthly volatility; I should continue to trade only when a considered decision supports my goals.","Past price changes are random and do not forecast the next month, so I should not treat this short record as a reliable market signal."]}
